payload.artist_html: R. T. Müller, L. Roberto-da-Silva, O. L. Porcela Aurélio & L. Kerber
payload.credit_html: "The smallest tetrapod from the Middle Triassic of South America: a new procolophonoid parareptile from the Ladinian of Southern Brazil"
payload.description_html: Dentition of Sauropia macrorhinus from the Pinheiros-Chiniquá Sequence (Ladinian) of the Santa Maria Supersequence, southern Brazil. 3D model of the holotype (CAPPA/UFSM 0510) in anteroventral (a), right lateroventral (b), and left lateroventral (c) views. Photograph of the right premaxilla and maxilla of CAPPA/UFSM 0510, magnified, in anterolateral view (d). Details of the right premaxillary and maxillary dentition of CAPPA/UFSM 0510 in anterolateral view (e). Transverse slices of CAPPA/UFSM 0510 in (f) and (g). Abbreviations: m, maxillary tooth; mx, maxilla; pm, premaxillary tooth; pmx, premaxilla.
